title: Tennis Star Announces Return After Injury Layoff
summary: Comeback planned for the season's first hard court swing.

body.text: Officials stressed that the plan will be rolled out gradually to avoid disruption.
Early reactions from the community have been broadly positive, though some raised questions about timing.
Small steps, taken consistently, are how we got here.
Supporters point to similar efforts abroad that delivered results within a few years.
Analysts say the move could reshape how teams plan their next two years of work.

author.name: Jonas Weber
author.bio: Senior sports writer and former athlete.
